documentation.description:
Generated by tools/gen-docs.py from the Sphinx manual (docs/):
the whole built site (pages, stylesheets, scripts, badges, search)
as a gzip-compressed, base64-encoded offline asset blob + lookup
table.  --serve exposes it at /docs/ with Content-Encoding: gzip
(the browser inflates it).  Do not edit by hand; edit docs/ and
run make book.

array_types.name: Asset_Table
array_types.code: type Asset_Table is array (Positive range <>) of Asset_Ref;

record_types.name: Asset_Ref

access_types.name: Asset_Body
access_types.code: type Asset_Body is access constant String;

subtypes.name: Asset_Index
subtypes.code: subtype Asset_Index is Positive range 1 .. Asset_Count;

subtypes.name: Body_Index
subtypes.code: subtype Body_Index is Positive range 1 .. Body_Count;

constants.name: Asset_Bodies
constants.code:
Asset_Bodies : constant array (Body_Index) of Asset_Body :=
  (
   Asset_000'Access,
   …
   Asset_159'Access);

subprograms.name: Body_Bytes
subprograms.code:
function Body_Bytes (B : Body_Index; Is_Gzip : Boolean)
  return String
